belize.overview: Belize offers tropical forest trails leading to hidden waterfalls and sweeping jungle canopy views. The best day hikes are in the Cockscomb Basin Wildlife Sanctuary, a jaguar reserve where the Tiger Fern Trail climbs to a double waterfall, and at Mayflower Bocawina National Park, where a rope-assisted climb ends at Antelope Falls and its pools. The dry months provide the most reliable footing, as heavy rains quickly turn the clay trails slick.
